concerns.text: The implementation plan (Phase 8) specifies a post‑hoc power‑analysis sanity check, but no task in tasks.md addresses this analysis. A dedicated task (e.g., T016) should be added to compute and report statistical power based on effect size and sample size.

Phase 6 of the plan expands the sensitivity sweep to include Random Forest hyper‑parameter variations (n_estimators ∈ {200, 500}, max_features ∈ {'sqrt', 0.5}), yet tasks.md only contains T009 which sweeps PCA variance thresholds. Add a task (e.g., T017) to implement the hyper‑parameter sweep and record the resulting R² scores.
